question: The meaning of the Idiom **'Make a clean breast of'** is to:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Confess**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Make a clean breast of"** means to admit or confess something openly and without hesitation, particularly a wrongdoing or secret. (स्पष्ट रूप से स्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of hiding the truth, he decided to make a clean breast of his mistakes and apologize to everyone involved.
 
 
 
• **"Confess"** refers to admitting or acknowledging something, especially something wrong, embarrassing, or that one is guilty of. (कबूल करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She confessed to breaking the vase when her parents asked who was responsible.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Confess**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Argue **(विवाद करना): To present reasons or evidence in support of or against something.

 
 
• **Example:** They argued about the best way to complete the project.
 
 
 
• **Accuse **(आरोप लगाना): To charge someone with a fault, offense, or crime.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher accused him of cheating during the test.
 
 
 
• **Whisper** (फुसफुसाना): To speak very softly or quietly, typically so as not to be heard by others.
 
 
• **Example:** She whispered the secret into her friend's ear.
